title: Tensor formula for the right adjoint of a perfect proper immersion
statement: Let i:Z\to Y be a closed immersion of Noetherian schemes [def-pc-scheme] that is proper and perfect, where perfect means that i_*\mathcal O_Z is locally a perfect complex over Y [def-pc-perfect-complex]. Let c be a right adjoint to Ri_* on quasi-coherent derived categories [def-pc-derived-category], and let K be a quasi-coherent complex on Y. Then there is a canonical isomorphism c(K)\cong Li^*K\mathbin{\otimes^L}c(\mathcal O_Y) in the derived category of quasi-coherent complexes on Z.
